dpa.servicesDescription: Provision of a B2B SaaS platform for account management, workflow automation, support tracking, and operational analytics for the customer.
dpa.duration: For the term of the master services agreement and any limited retention periods required for support, security, backups, or legal obligations.
dpa.processingPurpose: To host, secure, support, and operate the contracted SaaS platform on behalf of the customer, including account administration, service delivery, support handling, and system reliability.
dpa.instructionsChannel: Documented contractual requests, support tickets from authorized customer administrators, or written email instructions from designated customer contacts.
dpa.confidentialityMeasures: Need-to-know access restrictions, internal confidentiality obligations, access reviews, and role-based controls for authorized personnel.
dpa.securityMeasures: Role-based access control, audit logs, encryption in transit, hardened infrastructure, dependency review, monitoring, and reasonable backup/security procedures.
dpa.subprocessorObjectionWindow: Reasonable prior notice for material subprocessor changes, subject to the master services agreement.
dpa.subprocessorMethodology: Infrastructure and specialist providers may be engaged where reasonably necessary, subject to contractual data protection obligations and vendor review.
dpa.transferMechanism: Where applicable, transfers rely on contractual safeguards, equivalent legal mechanisms, or regional hosting arrangements assessed for the customer relationship.
dpa.transferSupplementarySafeguards: Regional hosting, minimization, encryption, access segregation, and reasonable vendor review may be used as supplementary safeguards depending on the workflow.
dpa.breachNotificationTime: Without undue delay after confirming a relevant incident affecting customer personal data.
dpa.assistanceCommitments: Reasonable assistance is provided for data subject requests, security inquiries, and compliance obligations, taking into account the nature of the processing and available information.
dpa.deletionReturnPeriod: At the end of services, personal data is returned or deleted within a reasonable period, subject to legal retention duties and documented backup/security cycles.
dpa.backupRetentionHandling: Residual backups follow their controlled retention and purge cycle, remain access-restricted, and are not returned to active use in ordinary operations.
dpa.auditNoticePeriod: Reasonable prior notice and coordination, except where a contract or law requires faster handling.
dpa.auditRights: The processor may provide reasonable information, responses, certifications, or comparable evidence of compliance, subject to confidentiality and operational limits.
dpa.governingLaw: As set out in the master services agreement and applicable data protection law.
